gaps.title: Vertical-specific workflow automation for regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, finance)
gaps.pain: General automation tools lack compliance features (HIPAA, SOX) and domain-specific logic, forcing manual workarounds.
gaps.why_now: Increasing regulatory pressure and remote work demand compliant automation.
gaps.evidence_needed: Interviews with compliance officers in healthcare/finance; quantify time spent on manual compliance steps.
gaps.risk: Long sales cycles due to compliance requirements.

gaps.title: AI-powered document processing for small businesses (invoices, contracts, receipts)
gaps.pain: Small businesses manually enter data from documents into accounting/ERP systems; existing OCR tools are inaccurate or expensive.
gaps.why_now: Advances in LLMs and vision AI make accurate extraction feasible at low cost.
gaps.evidence_needed: Survey of 50 small business owners on time spent on data entry; test accuracy of current AI models on sample documents.
gaps.risk: Competition from generic AI document parsers (e.g., Rossum, Hyperscience).

gaps.title: Workflow automation for non-technical teams in mid-market companies (e.g., HR, marketing)
gaps.pain: Zapier/Make require technical know-how; mid-market teams lack dedicated automation engineers.
gaps.why_now: Mid-market companies are expanding but cannot afford enterprise RPA; low-code tools are still too complex.
gaps.evidence_needed: Identify 20 mid-market companies; ask about failed automation attempts and current manual processes.
gaps.risk: Hard to differentiate from simplified versions of existing tools.

gaps.title: Automated data reconciliation and reporting for e-commerce sellers
gaps.pain: E-commerce sellers manually reconcile orders, payments, and inventory across multiple platforms (Amazon, Shopify, eBay).
gaps.why_now: E-commerce growth and multi-channel selling increase complexity; existing tools are fragmented.
gaps.evidence_needed: Analyze e-commerce forums for pain points; prototype a simple reconciliation script and test with 10 sellers.

gaps.title: Internal tool builder for operational workflows in logistics and supply chain
gaps.pain: Logistics companies use spreadsheets and email for tracking shipments, inventory, and exceptions; no easy way to build custom tools.
gaps.why_now: Supply chain disruptions highlight need for real-time visibility; Retool is too generic.
gaps.evidence_needed: Case studies of logistics companies using manual processes; build a prototype for a specific workflow (e.g., exception handling).
gaps.risk: Requires deep domain knowledge; long sales cycle.

gaps.title: AI-assisted workflow automation for legal document review and contract management
gaps.pain: Lawyers and paralegals spend hours reviewing contracts for key clauses, deadlines, and risks; existing tools are expensive and complex.
gaps.why_now: LLMs can now understand legal language; demand for efficiency in legal departments is high.
gaps.evidence_needed: Interview 10 legal professionals; measure time spent on contract review; test AI accuracy on sample contracts.

gaps.title: Workflow automation for property management (maintenance requests, lease renewals, inspections)
gaps.pain: Property managers juggle multiple properties with manual processes; existing software is either too basic or too enterprise.
gaps.why_now: Remote property management trend post-COVID; small property managers lack affordable automation.
gaps.evidence_needed: Survey property management groups; identify most painful workflow (e.g., maintenance ticketing).
gaps.risk: Fragmented market; low willingness to pay.

gaps.title: No-code automation for recurring data entry from emails and attachments
gaps.pain: Employees manually copy data from email attachments (PDFs, Excel) into databases or CRMs; existing email parsers are limited.
gaps.why_now: Email remains a primary communication channel; AI can now parse unstructured email content accurately.
gaps.evidence_needed: Quantify volume of email-based data entry in target companies; test parsing accuracy on real emails.
gaps.risk: Email parsing is a feature, not a product; could be integrated by larger platforms.

checkpoint_instruction: Validate gap 2 by conducting 20 customer interviews with small business owners to confirm pain and willingness to pay. Build a prototype that extracts data from 3 common document types (invoices, receipts, contracts) and integrates with QuickBooks or Xero. Measure accuracy and time saved.
